questions.question: The Fall 2005 CMBIOL 995 classes are taught by how many professors ?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.instructor_id) FROM course_offering co JOIN offering_instructor oi ON co.offering_id = oi.offering_id JOIN course c ON co.course_id = c.course_id JOIN semester s ON co.semester = s.semester_id WHERE c.department = 'CMBIOL' AND c.number = '995' AND s.semester = 'Fall' AND s.year = 2005;
